algorithm_contract.decoder: Raw symmetric dot product of the two learned 128-dimensional node embeddings. A separate evaluator may fit one logistic calibration only on inner pseudo-held evidence sources; neither held-source nor held-block outcomes may fit the decoder or calibrator.
algorithm_contract.edge_projection: Project all retained typed evidence to one unweighted undirected simple graph. Canonicalize non-self pairs, collapse duplicate retained-source edges, then emit both directions in edge_index. Relation, direction, evidence-source count, and source-native weight are deliberately discarded and cannot be claimed as modeled.
algorithm_contract.native_method: PyG Node2Vec learns a node-indexed embedding table from random-walk contexts with negative sampling. It consumes topology only and has no node-feature transform.
algorithm_contract.node_identity: UTF-8 typed IDs with required namespace prefixes; bytewise sort to a contiguous integer map and freeze the exact map. Unnamespaced identifiers, type collisions, self-evidence, and mutable node numbering are rejected.
algorithm_contract.training_graph: Construct after the whole held evidence source, deterministic derivatives, held LD/locus/gene blocks, and boundary-linked edges are removed. Random walks, node universe, negative sampling, and model initialization use only this retained graph.

implementation.checkpoint_policy: No upstream biological checkpoint is admitted. Train a new embedding inside every held-source by held-block split and seed and hash the graph, node map, recipe, runtime, state dictionary, and exported embedding.

native_assumptions_and_limits.closed_world: The Embedding parameter has one row per training node. A node absent from the retained graph has no learned representation; adding it after fitting is impossible without a new model.
native_assumptions_and_limits.negative_sampling: PyG draws negative context nodes uniformly with torch.randint over the training node universe. It does not enforce node-type compatibility and can sample false negatives. Do not inspect held outcomes to remove them; constrain only evaluator candidates by typed endpoint family and disclose the mismatch.
native_assumptions_and_limits.p_q_interpretation: The frozen p=q=1 recipe uses unbiased second-order walks. It is the exact upstream example setting and does not test a BFS- or DFS-favoring node2vec sweep.
native_assumptions_and_limits.pyg_walk_requirement: At p=q=1, the selected class requires either pyg-lib or torch-cluster. Non-unit p or q would require torch-cluster specifically.

runtime_contract.execution_target: CPU SLURM is the compatibility default for admission; L40S may be used only after the exact PyTorch, CUDA, pyg-lib or torch-cluster wheel matrix passes import, random-walk, sparse-gradient, resume, and tolerance probes.
runtime_contract.seed_wrapper: Set Python, NumPy, torch CPU, and all CUDA seeds before graph shuffling and model creation; freeze integer edge order, generator states, worker count zero, device, deterministic settings, and one artifact per seed.
runtime_contract.torch_requirement: Not declared by the torch-geometric wheel. Freeze an exact PyTorch build, CUDA runtime, extension build, and hashes before execution.
runtime_contract.work_status: No package, extension, graph, or model was installed or executed during this audit.

safe_loading_contract.embedding_export: Export a row-major float32 NumPy array with allow_pickle=false plus a separate bounded UTF-8 JSON node roster. Require shape [frozen_num_nodes,128], exact row-map hash, finite values, expected dtype/endian, and file SHA-256.
safe_loading_contract.model_state: Save only the Node2Vec state_dict and a JSON architecture receipt. Reload with torch.load(weights_only=true,map_location='cpu') in the frozen modern PyTorch runtime, reconstruct the exact class, and require strict keys, shape, dtype, finiteness, and num_nodes checks before device transfer.
safe_loading_contract.untrusted_graph_objects: Do not load pickled Data objects. Rebuild edge_index from bounded, hashed plain edge and node-map artifacts and validate index range, symmetry, uniqueness, and held-edge absence.

source_evidence: The KDD paper metadata and arXiv v1 record, immutable PyG 2.7.0 tag, MIT text, package metadata, exact Node2Vec source, and exact upstream example were inspected on 2026-08-22. No code archive, wheel, extension, graph, or weights were downloaded to disk; no model was installed or executed.

terms_audit.derivative_weight_redistribution: The software license does not impose a separate learned-weight restriction. Release of project embeddings remains conditional on input evidence-source terms because a transductive table can encode graph structure; with restricted sources, release recipes, hashes, and evaluator predictions instead.
terms_audit.notice_obligation: Retain the PyTorch Geometric copyright and MIT permission notice in redistributed source or substantial portions.
